reason: At 23 euros a litre it's at least twice what I pay for a Monin and five times what my own house syrups cost me in fruit and sugar. I'll ask for the free sample out of curiosity, but I can't put that cost into every cocktail without raising the menu price.
objection: The cost per cocktail: I can make a fruit syrup or a rhum arrangé myself for a few euros a litre, so I don't see what justifies paying 23.
would_change_my_mind: A price around 12 to 14 euros a litre, or a tasting that shows guests will actually pay more for a signature cocktail built on it.
